top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific, named invention (magic-wavelength optical lattice trapping of many neutral atoms) and its realisation at 10^-18 fractional uncertainty, independently reproduced by several laboratories, with an uncontested two-name allocation (Katori, Ye). It is the mature, discovery-or-invention case, and the citation can be worded around the lattice clock rather than the 2005 comb prize. P002 is a strong second: the moire flat-band platform is a genuine new field, but the three-name allocation excludes Cao, Dean, Young, Yacoby and Efetov, and the pairing mechanism and credit are still unsettled. No award is last because both proposals describe awardable work.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my TEM work on oxide interfaces (LaAlO3/SrTiO3) is adjacent to P002 but involves no credited person, and the only Chalmers link is Goran Johansson
